entities.text: Yogesh Kumar Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: From perusal of the order dated 06.03.2012, it appears that after the receipt of the execution report of non-bailable warrant of arrest against the petitioner, process under Section 82 of the Cr.P.C. was issued.
The Investigating Officer has reported that the petitioner was avoiding his arrest and he was removing his properties.

4. From perusal of the order dated 31.01.2019, it appears that without the receipt of execution report of process under Section 82 of the Cr.P.C., process under Section 83 of the Cr.P.C. was issued against the petitioner.
5. The learned Trial Court has issued process under Section 82 of the Cr.P.C. against the petitioner after receipt of the execution report and as such, I do not find any illegality in the said order.

6. So far as, process under Section 83 of the Cr.P.C. is concerned, it was issued without any report of execution of process issued under Section 82 of the Cr.P.C.
7.
Accordingly, order dated 31.01.2019, issuing process under Section 83 of the Cr.P.C. is quashed.
However, order dated 06.03.2012, process under Section 82 of the Cr.P.C. is rejected.
8. This Criminal Miscellaneous Petition is partly allowed.
Pending I.A., if any, stands disposed of.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) Rahul/-
